# IMPACT

> IMPACT is a free web app and AI connector with nine positioning tools built on Shashwat Ghosh's IMPACT framework, for CMOs and marketing teams. Describe your product, buyers and rivals, and each tool returns a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test, or a full audit. Add https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Positioning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffb607a88191a65779b6ba962cb7

- Web app (no sign-in): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Use it in ChatGPT: install the Helix Positioning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffb607a88191a65779b6ba962cb7
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Hosted version 2.2.27 with 9 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 2.2.27.
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Helix skills packages: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [IMPACT Framework Guide](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-get-framework/) (`impact_get_framework`): Helps you decide which positioning steps to run, and in what order. You give nothing, or one IMPACT step to focus on and your sector. You get the IMPACT positioning method step by step (identify champions, map alternatives, pinpoint value, anchor in a market, craft the message, translate it to execution), with a template or checklist for each step; a focus step returns that step only, and your sector adds its buyer roles, measures and proof points.
- [Identify Champions](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-identify-champions/) (`impact_identify_champions`): Helps you decide who inside the buyer will push for you. You give what your product does and the problem it solves, plus optional company name, target company type, price point and sector. You get hypotheses for the champion, the economic buyer, the technical influencer, commercial and control reviewers and daily users, warning signs of an anti champion, a path to develop the champion and what to give them. These are roles to test, not named people.
- [Map Alternatives](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-map-alternatives/) (`impact_map_alternatives`): Helps you decide what buyers compare you with, and where you can lead. You give your product and its category, plus optional competitors, their weaknesses and your strengths. You get one card for each competitor you name, the status quo and doing nothing, where you can lead and discovery questions, with your sector's questions and objections. It uses only what you give and says what would sharpen the map.
- [Pinpoint Value](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-pinpoint-value/) (`impact_pinpoint_value`): Helps you decide what you can claim that buyers will believe. You give your target customer, the main outcome they get and what you do that others do not, plus optional product name, category, customer results and business model. You get value statements in three versions, a value matrix for your own figures, proof points ranked from customer results to social proof, versions for different audiences and channels, and questions to test the value.
- [Anchor Market](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-anchor-market/) (`impact_anchor_market`): Helps you decide which market segment to win first. You give what your product does and the segments you are weighing, plus optional customers, pain, deal size and company counts. You get a beachhead choice: your segments ranked from your own customers, pain and deal size when you give all three (the answer says which method it used), otherwise scored on keywords in their names; a TAM, SAM and SOM calculation from only the figures you give; a three year expansion path and an ICP hypothesis for the chosen segment. It never chooses a segment you did not name.
- [Craft Message](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-craft-message/) (`impact_craft_message`): Helps you decide what your core message is, and how to test it. You give your target customer, the key benefit and what sets you apart, plus optional product name, customer need, category, main competitor and business model. You get a positioning statement (full and one sentence), a message hierarchy from tagline to three supporting pillars, versions for different audiences, objection handling and ways to test the message. It writes from your own words, in whole sentences.
- [Translate Execution](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-translate-execution/) (`impact_translate_execution`): Helps you decide how your positioning should read in each channel. You give a positioning statement, your target customer and the key benefit, plus optional channels, product name and business model. You get copy to edit: a website hero, a LinkedIn tagline and post drafts, a three email cold sequence, a sales deck outline and a 15 minute demo script, with calls to action that fit your business model and the order to work the channels in.
- [IMPACT Full Audit](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-full-audit/) (`impact_full_audit`): Helps you decide whether your positioning is working and what to fix first. Use for a full positioning review or when someone asks help me explain why we are different. Ask what the product does, who it serves and the problem it solves before calling; never invent these or fill missing facts with placeholders such as Not supplied. Clarify what unlabelled numbers mean. For a request only to phrase a message, impact_craft_message also fits; use this tool for the full review. You get input completeness scores, supplied proof, a positioning draft and next actions. Scores measure how complete the inputs are, not how strong the positioning is. Never invent proof.
- [Build our message for this segment](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/docs/#impact-build-segment-message) (`impact_build_segment_message`): Build our message for this segment when our sellers do not use the message or buyers stay with what they have. Needs the product, segment, champion problem, alternatives, outcome, capability and proof. Returns proof gaps and current approach questions, champion and alternatives maps for human choices, then a message and proof plan after a pause. Optional agreed workshop claim is the starting point. Without a real customer result, buyer lines are unproved hypotheses and the next step is discovery questions. Chat carries the brief between calls.

## Questions and answers

### What is IMPACT?

IMPACT is a free web app and AI connector with nine positioning tools built on Shashwat Ghosh's IMPACT framework, for CMOs and marketing teams. Describe your product, buyers and rivals, and each tool returns a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test, or a full audit. Add https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Positioning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ffb607a88191a65779b6ba962cb7

### Is IMPACT free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the IMPACT code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. What you type and the answer are not stored, and nothing you type is logged. Only an anonymous count of tool calls is kept. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use IMPACT in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it IMPACT, paste https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Connect your app covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://impact.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is IMPACT not ideal for?

Teams that need buyer research done for them: IMPACT structures your positioning as hypotheses, and you test them with buyers. Anyone who needs live competitor data: the tools look nothing up; they work from what you type about your market and rivals, and anything they add themselves (such as common complaints in a category) is marked as something to check with buyers. Teams that need saved history: answers are not stored, so keep each draft where you keep your positioning work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp/issues.

## Buyer routes

- [All Helix tools](https://tools.gtmhelix.com/tools/): 52 tools and 37 different skills, 89 in all, in six connectors and nine plugins.
- [Impact Craft Message](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-craft-message/): Draft a B2B message from a buyer, the alternative they use and the change your product could deliver. Supply the value and supporting evidence, then review the positioning statement, tagline and pillars. Keep a proposed benefit separate from a measured result and test the message with the buyer before using it.
- [Impact Full Audit](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-full-audit/): Check how complete your B2B positioning inputs are across the IMPACT steps. Enter your buyer, alternatives, value, market, message and execution notes, then review the gaps the audit identifies. A completeness result describes the inputs you supplied. Use buyer conversations and measured evidence to test whether the positioning works.
- [Positioning Workshop](https://helix-gtm-consulting-positioning-workshop.shashwat-helix-gtm.chatgpt.site/): Series A, Series B and ITeS teams of 5 to 6 people agree a direction. Individual work starts in IMPACT.
- [Build our message for this segment](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/build-segment-message/) (`impact_build_segment_message`): Proof gaps first, independent champion and alternatives maps, then a human pause and a message. Optional agreed workshop claim. With no real result, routes to discovery questions. Use in chat; there is no form.
